signature.name: VTask.ofLeftInverse
signature.type: {α : Sort u_3} -> {β : Type u_4} -> (f : α → β) -> (f_inv : Nonempty α → β → α) -> (hf : ∀ (h : Nonempty α), Function.LeftInverse (f_inv h) f) -> α ≃ ↑(Set.range f)

conventions.statement: When α is empty, the equivalence is still valid and well-typed; f_inv and hf are never evaluated, and Set.range f is also empty.
conventions.note: The Nonempty α guard on f_inv and hf is precisely what makes this work in the empty case.

facts.statement: ∀ {α : Type*} {β : Type*} (f : α → β) (f_inv : Nonempty α → β → α) (hf : ∀ h : Nonempty α, Function.LeftInverse (f_inv h) f) (a : α), ((VTask.ofLeftInverse f f_inv hf a) : β) = f a

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6, validated against ground truth

facts.statement: ∀ {α β : Type*} (f : α → β) (f_inv : Nonempty α → β → α) (hf : ∀ h : Nonempty α, Function.LeftInverse (f_inv h) f), VTask.ofLeftInverse f f_inv hf = Equiv.ofInjective f ((isEmpty_or_nonempty α).elim (fun _ _ _ _ => Subsingleton.elim _ _) (fun h => (hf h).injective))

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6, validated against ground truth

facts.statement: ∀ {α : Type*} {β : Type*} (f : α → β) (f_inv : Nonempty α → β → α) (hf : ∀ h : Nonempty α, Function.LeftInverse (f_inv h) f) (a : α), (VTask.ofLeftInverse f f_inv hf).symm ⟨f a, a, rfl⟩ = a
